about_the_game:
POND DEMO

Create your own peaceful pond, one gentle step at a time.

Escape into a calming world where creativity flows as naturally as water. In this relaxing idle game, you shape the land, reveal hidden waters, and build a soothing sanctuary filled with life. No deadlines. No stress. Just you, nature, and the quiet joy of watching something beautiful come to life.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Radeon 680M or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 12
